verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents a monitoring feature that watches a page, sitemap, or structured dataset on a schedule and emits signed change events (docs-9). This is a form of recurring, automated scraping. Batch and async crawl jobs (docs-3, docs-34) are submitted on demand rather than scheduled, so general scheduled scraping otherwise depends on running the CLI from external scripts or CI (docs-14). Missing for 10: a general-purpose scheduler for arbitrary scrape/crawl/extract jobs, cron-style control over specific run times, detail on schedule configuration options, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
